_comment: Short verbatim quotes from allowlisted web pages that are NOT in raw_data. Each was read on the live page on the date shown. The backend re-fetches the URL at answer time when it has network access; if it cannot, the UI labels the quote as a dated snapshot. To add one: paste the exact words, the URL, and the date you read it.

entries.title: Flammability of Materials on the Moon (FM2)
quotes: FM2 is the first-ever combustion experiment to be performed on another planetary body.
Conduct the first-ever observations and measurements of flame spread on the Moon.
entries.note: Project description page. It reports plans and hardware, not measured results.

entries.title: Combustion Experiment in Microgravity (FLARE leaflet)
quotes: materials can be more flammable in microgravity or reduced-gravity environments (such as the Moon and Mars)
entries.note: Qualitative statement only, attributed in the leaflet to NASA drop tower experiments. No numbers are given.
